description: This file defines the internal class AdoNetQueueAdapterReceiver, which implements the IQueueAdapterReceiver interface. It manages receiving message batches from an ADO.NET provider queue, including initialization, shutdown, message retrieval, and message delivery confirmation, with integrated logging.

classes.name: AdoNetQueueAdapterReceiver
classes.description: Handles receiving message batches from an ADO.NET provider queue, including initialization, shutdown, message retrieval, and message confirmation, with logging support.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Completes immediately as no initialization is required.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the receiver, waiting for any outstanding storage operations to complete.

methods.name: GetQueueMessagesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of messages from the queue, converting them into standard batch containers.

methods.name: MessagesDeliveredAsync
methods.description: Confirms delivery of messages by their sequence tokens.
